data.taxBenefit: Eligible for Beckham Law regime with a flat 24% tax rate on income up to EUR 600,000
requirements: Proof of monthly income of at least 200% of the Spanish minimum wage
Work remotely for non-Spanish companies or derive max 20% income from local clients
Clean criminal record for the last 5 years
Valid private health insurance operating in Spain

data.taxBenefit: 0% personal income tax on foreign-sourced income
requirements: Proof of remote employment or business ownership outside the UAE
Minimum monthly income of USD 3,500
Valid passport with at least 6 months validity
Health insurance with UAE coverage

data.taxBenefit: Eligible for specific tax incentives for foreign earners upon becoming a tax resident
requirements: Proof of monthly income from remote work equal to at least 4 times the Portuguese minimum wage (EUR 3,280/month)
Proof of remote employment contract, freelancing agreements, or company ownership outside Portugal
Proof of accommodation in Portugal for at least 12 months
Clean criminal record certificate from country of origin or residence

data.taxBenefit: No local income tax applies on foreign-sourced income during the 6-month stay.
requirements: Annual income of at least 10,000,000 JPY
Citizenship of an eligible visa-exempt country
Private health insurance covering medical treatment and emergency care

data.stayDuration: Up to 1 Year (Renewable up to 1 additional year)
data.taxBenefit: Taxed only on Estonian-source income unless residing over 183 days in a consecutive 12-month period.
requirements: Work remotely using location-independent telecommunications technology
Have an active contract with a foreign-registered company, act as a partner/shareholder in a foreign company, or offer freelance services to foreign clients
Demonstrate a minimum monthly gross income of EUR 4,500 during the 6 months preceding the application

data.taxBenefit: Exemption from Croatian personal income tax on remote work foreign income
requirements: Work remotely for a non-Croatian employer or own a company registered outside Croatia
Proof of minimum monthly income or equivalent funds for the duration of stay
Valid passport valid for at least 3 months beyond the intended stay duration
Valid travel or private health insurance covering the territory of Croatia

data.stayDuration: 3 to 12 months (Renewable up to an additional 12 months)
data.taxBenefit: Foreign-sourced income earned while residing in Malaysia is exempt from local personal income tax
requirements: Minimum monthly remote income of USD 2,000 (USD 24,000 annually)
Proof of remote work contract, freelance client agreements, or business ownership
Passport valid for at least 14 months at the time of application
Valid medical and travel insurance policy

data.taxBenefit: 50% tax exemption on income exceeding TWD 3 million for the first 5 years
requirements: Demonstrate a minimum monthly income of TWD 160,000 in recent years or professional qualification in select fields
Hold expertise in one of the 10 qualifying sectors (e.g. Science, Technology, Economy, Finance)
Provide a passport valid for at least 6 months and pass background checks

data.taxBenefit: Foreign-sourced income is not subject to Thai tax unless remitted into Thailand in the same tax year
requirements: Proof of financial assets of at least 500,000 THB held in a bank account
Proof of location-independent employment, freelancing, or approved activity
Valid passport with at least 6 months validity

data.taxBenefit: 50% tax reduction on income earned in Greece for up to 7 years
requirements: Proof of monthly net income of at least EUR 3,500 from foreign sources
Proof of remote employment, freelancing, or business ownership outside Greece
Valid health insurance covering medical expenses in Greece

data.taxBenefit: Non-tax residents (under 183 days) are exempt from local income tax on foreign income; tax residents enjoy a EUR 19,500 tax-free threshold.
requirements: Minimum net monthly income of EUR 3,500
Proof of remote employment, freelancing, or business ownership outside Cyprus
Valid medical insurance coverage in Cyprus
Clean criminal record certificate from country of residence

data.taxBenefit: Exempt from Icelandic tax for stays under 183 days
requirements: Must be a non-EU/EEA/EFTA citizen
Proof of remote employment or self-employment outside Iceland
Minimum monthly income of 1,000,000 ISK (1,300,000 ISK for couples)
Health insurance covering Iceland for the duration of stay

data.taxBenefit: Favorable local tax rate (approx. 15.8%) applies to residents in Svalbard
requirements: Proof of sufficient funds or income to support yourself in Svalbard
Secured housing or accommodation prior to arrival
Valid passport
Comprehensive health insurance coverage

data.taxBenefit: Eligible for the flat-rate tax scheme (paušální daň) covering personal income tax and social insurance.
requirements: Valid Czech Trade License (Živnostenské oprávnění)
Proof of minimum funds in a bank account (approx. CZK 156,000 minimum balance)
Proof of legal accommodation in the Czech Republic for 1 year
Clean criminal record certificate and comprehensive health insurance

data.taxBenefit: Eligible for tax reductions up to 50-70% on foreign income under the Impatriati tax regime.
requirements: Minimum annual income of EUR 28,000 (approx. EUR 2,333 per month) from remote work
At least 6 months of experience as a digital nomad or remote worker
Comprehensive private health insurance covering all risks in Italy
Proof of suitable accommodation in Italy and clean criminal record

data.taxBenefit: Exempt from local income tax and social security contributions if staying under 183 days in a 12-month period.
requirements: Proof of employment or company ownership outside Romania for at least 3 months prior to application.
Minimum monthly income of at least 3x the Romanian gross average monthly salary (~EUR 3,700/month) for the previous 6 months.
Valid health insurance covering Romania with minimum EUR 30,000 coverage.
Clean criminal record certificate from country of origin or residence.

data.taxBenefit: No personal income tax, capital gains tax, or direct taxes on foreign-sourced income.
requirements: Proof of location-independent employment or business ownership outside Bermuda
Evidence of a continuous source of income or sufficient financial means
Valid health insurance coverage for the duration of stay
Clean criminal background check

data.taxBenefit: Zero personal income tax, tax on foreign income, or capital gains tax.
requirements: Valid passport
Proof of remote employment, self-employment, or student enrollment
Proof of sufficient financial resources to support stay
Medical insurance coverage

data.taxBenefit: 100% exemption from Costa Rican income tax on foreign income and import duty exemptions on personal work equipment.
requirements: Proof of stable monthly foreign income of at least $3,000 USD ($4,000 USD with dependents) over the past 12 months.
Valid private health insurance coverage for the entire duration of stay in Costa Rica.
Perform work remotely for clients, employers, or entities located outside Costa Rica.

data.stayDuration: 1 Year (Renewable for up to 1 additional year)
data.taxBenefit: Tax exempt on foreign income for stays under 183 days within a 12-month period; tax residency applies after 183 days.
requirements: Proof of employment or business contract with a non-Brazilian entity
Minimum monthly income of USD 1,500 or bank balance of USD 18,000
Health insurance valid in Brazil
Clean criminal background check

data.taxBenefit: No local personal income tax on foreign-sourced income during stay
requirements: Valid passport with at least 6 months validity
Proof of remote employment or freelance work outside Argentina
Clean criminal background check from country of origin or residence
Curriculum vitae and proof of remote income

data.taxBenefit: Foreign income is exempt from tax provided it is not remitted into Mauritius or spent using foreign accounts/cards.
requirements: Proof of remote employment or income generated outside Mauritius
Minimum monthly income of USD 1,500 or equivalent bank balance
Valid passport and round-trip flight ticket
Health and travel insurance covering the entire period of stay

data.taxBenefit: Exempt from local personal income tax on foreign-sourced income
requirements: Proof of remote employment, freelancing, or business ownership outside Seychelles
Proof of sufficient financial means and bank statements
Valid passport and onward or return travel ticket
Comprehensive medical and travel health insurance covering duration of stay

data.taxBenefit: Foreign-sourced income is not taxed locally if staying less than 183 days in a 12-month period.
requirements: Proof of remote employment or business ownership outside South Africa
Minimum gross income of ZAR 1,000,000 per year (approx. ZAR 83,333 per month)
Valid passport with at least 30 days validity beyond intended stay
Comprehensive medical insurance cover for the duration of stay
